title: ExitGuard review scope
description: The operator's declaration of which Squads v4 multisigs belong to the organisation and which wallet is being offboarded. Addresses must be base58 and decode to exactly 32 bytes; exitguard/scope.py enforces that, along with the one-subject rule and de-duplication by state address.

organization_id.description: Local identifier. Not established by the chain.

review_id.description: Local identifier. Not established by the chain.

scope_attested_complete.description: true means the operator asserts the declared boundary. It is not proof that every treasury was found.

state_address.description: Canonical Multisig state address, not a vault.

label.description: Display only. Never treated as ownership.

signature.description: Base58 ed25519 signature by the subject over the attestation message. Required for wallet_signed to be honoured.
Optional base58 ed25519 signature over the attestation message. Without it the attestation is recorded as an unsigned assertion.
